finding_text: Task registrations are only logged to console stdout; an operator auditing a machine a week later has no persistent record of what was registered, when, with what commands.

When creating a tracker item takes several seconds, operators cannot tell whether migration, SQLite append, or rendering consumed the time. The item is stored and returned. The create endpoint emits no stage timings.

A wave agent with a missing start time has a null duration in the timeline API. The dashboard's elapsed-time cell and accessible phase title both display the string `nulls` to operators. The API defines null as an unknown duration.

In CI, the test runner partitions modules round-robin. It executes the assigned modules but does not balance shards by recorded runtime or export per-module elapsed times. This makes it difficult for maintainers to tune how long each shard takes.

The fleet timeline serializes a timezone-aware UTC timestamp and then appends Z. The browser receives a +00:00Z suffix, Date parsing produces Invalid Date, and the positions of live agents' bars become NaN.
